name_original: Apple - iPod touch® 16GB MP3 Player (6th Generation - Latest Model) - Blue
description_original: iPod touch is the perfect way to carry your music collection in your pocket. Now in 5 stunning colors. Listen to your favorite songs from Apple Music* and iTunes. iPod touch offers the ultimate mobile gaming experience. Take great photos and videos with the new 8MP iSight camera and make video calls with the improved FaceTime HD camera.¹ And stay connected with Messages and the most popular social networking apps. All on a 4-inch Retina display.²
